\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\footnotesize
\item \textit{Notes:} Pooled intraday linear models and tree ensembles, one design for every row: the HAR components at horizons $k \in \{1, 5, 25, 125, 625, 3125\}$, the full predictor set with the FOMC series, a rolling window of \rhorWindowDays{} trading days, re-estimated at every bar (Section~\ref{sec:rh_methods}), trained and scored on the \rhorNBars{} regular-hours half-hour bars ending 10:00 to 16:00~ET. Hyperparameters are chosen once and then frozen: the linear penalties on \rhorPenSample{}, before the first forecast; the tree ensembles' configurations, one per method, by an Optuna search on the pre-sample (Appendix~\ref{sec:rh_methods_hyper}). Every bar is scored on the $T_{\mathrm{oos}} = \rhorDays$ trading days from \rhorSpanStart{} to \rhorSpanEnd{} (early closes dropped), \rhorNIntB{} bars (bars with a non-positive realized variance dropped); each forecast $\hat\sigma^2_{t,i} = \hat y^{2}_{t,i}\, s^2_{t,i}$ is scored against the actual realized variance $\RV_{t,i}$ of its interval. MSE (in units of $10^{-\rhoosMseExp}$) and QLIKE are averages over the scored intervals. $R^2_{\mathrm{OOS}} = 1 - \sum (\RV_{t,i} - \hat\sigma^2_{t,i})^2 / \sum (\RV_{t,i} - \overline{\RV}_{t-1,i})^2$, in percent, where $\overline{\RV}_{t-1,i}$ is the historical mean realized variance of the same half-hour interval over every earlier trading day from \rhoosBenchStart{} \citep{CampbellThompson2008}. DM: the Diebold--Mariano statistic, with the correction of \citet{HarveyLeybourneNewbold1997}, for the daily average QLIKE of the full predictor set minus that of the HAR benchmark of the same model (negative: the full set has the lower loss), Newey--West lag 8, $p$-value in parentheses. Models trained on the last 30 minutes are in Table~\ref{tab:rh_oos_last30}.
\end{tablenotes}
